Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Current infra: batch inference pipelines with on-prem GPUs; interested in a hosted/dedicated hybrid for predictable latency.
- Primary goal: reduce 95th percentile tail latency for embeddings-based search and cut unit cost by ~30%.
- Constraints: SOC2 / customer data residency; procurement on an annual cycle.

Next step: technical deep-dive + integration planning with one of our solutions engineers. I can propose 30–45m depending on how deep you want the runbook. Proposed slots (your timezone):

1) Tue 11/30 — 10:00–10:30am EST (30m)
2) Wed 12/1 — 2:00–2:45pm EST (45m)
3) Thu 12/2 — 11:00–11:30am EST (30m)

If you can pick one and confirm by Wed EOD (48 hours), I’ll lock Ben on the invite and include a short pre-read. Attaching my discovery notes from today for your records.

Thanks —
